title: Tokens-rate canary harness for multi-model throughput + p95 regression detection
creator: Marina Kovalenko
description: Build and maintain a lightweight, automated canary harness that continuously measures tokens/sec (TPS) and p95 latency across our core serving models. The harness should run small, targeted probes that mimic production request shape distributions, compare results against rolling baselines, and surface regressions with automated triage metadata. Goal: detect regressions in throughput or tail latency within 30 minutes of an offending deploy or model variant change and provide reproducible artifacts for debugging.
tasks: Design canary test matrix: select canonical prompts, sequence-length buckets, and core model variants (e.g., redwood-base, rwl-13B, open-llama-7B).
Implement runner that issues steady-state micro-traffic with realistic prefix distributions and KV-cache warmup steps.
Add p95 and TPS aggregations using the existing observability pipeline (trace ids, per-request timing, token counts).
Create regression detection logic: compare current window to 14-day baseline using %delta and MAD-based outlier detection.
Hook alerts into oncall paging and create an initial Slack channel + runbook link for triage.
Produce reproducible artifacts: raw traces, sample request corpus, synthetic replay script, perf-weighted flamegraphs.
Integrate into CI canary stage for model rollouts and dedicated infra deploys (toggleable by project).
Add a minimal UI in Console: per-model TPS and p95 sparkline, last-failure snapshot, link to PR/commit that triggered change.
Document sampling methodology, acceptance thresholds, and known limitations in Confluence.
acceptance_criteria: Canary probes run every 10 minutes and complete within configured SLAs for cost and duration.
System reports 95th percentile latency and sustained tokens/sec per model, per bucket, and stores results in metrics DB.
Automated regression detector flags anomalies with a reproducible artifact bundle and posts to "#perf-canaries" Slack channel.
Oncall runbook resolves whether an alert is infra, model, or config related and lists next steps.
Console surfaces a lightweight per-model TPS/p95 view for the last 30 days and links to the failing canary snapshot.
CI canary gate blocks model rollout when TPS regression exceeds configured P0 thresholds and auto-creates a rollback ticket.
